_comment: Generator definitions for a scoring run.
Paths may use ${VAR}, expanded from the environment when the config is
loaded. A referenced variable that is not set is a hard error naming the
variable: an empty expansion would scan the wrong tree and an unexpanded
literal would name a file nobody can find, and either way the run would be
attributed to a binary that did not produce it.
PQPROBE_STATIC_BIN  path to the pqprobe-static binary to score.
This is what makes the config portable between machines. A build root lives
on whichever host has the disk for it, so the config carries the name and the
environment supplies the path. The manifest still records the resolved path
and its sha256, because a run record must say what actually ran.
cdxgen needs no variable: it is named relative to the repository root and is
invoked through a pinned image, so it runs the same anywhere Docker does.
cdxgen is deliberately pinned at 12.8.2 across every run: it is the control,
and holding it still is what makes a score change attributable to the tool

tools.name: cdxgen
tools.notes: Arguments mirror BF-CBOM's cdxgen worker. Records source files in properties[].SrcFile without line numbers. Invoked through the pinned image ghcr.io/cyclonedx/cdxgen:12.8.2, so it needs no build root and runs the same on any host with Docker.

tools.name: pqprobe-static
tools.notes: Exit 1 means findings present, not failure. The binary path comes from PQPROBE_STATIC_BIN; the manifest records what it resolved to and that file's sha256. Maintained by the same party as Proofstein; see the governance section in README.md.
